indications.description: Advanced soft tissue sarcoma after anthracycline/ifosfamide failure or when unsuitable.

treatment.schedule_summary: Trabectedin1.5 mg/m² IV over 24 hours on Day 1 every 21 days until progression or unacceptable toxicity. Dilute in1000 mL sodium chloride0.9%; concentration≤0.030 mg/mL. Central venous access is strongly recommended.

eligibility: Adults with advanced soft-tissue sarcoma after failure of anthracyclines and ifosfamide, or unsuitable for them.
ECOG0–2 and all baseline/retreatment Table 1 organ/count criteria.
monitoring: Baseline FBC, renal/liver profile, CPK and ECHO/MUGA. Table 1 additionally requires haemoglobin≥9 g/dL and albumin≥25 g/L.
Before each cycle: FBC and renal/liver profile; all Table 1 retreatment criteria must be met. CPK weekly for the first2 cycles, then at least once between treatments.
EMA product information additionally specifies blood counts, bilirubin, ALP and transaminases weekly for the first2 cycles and at least once between treatments later.

Cardiac assessment at baseline and every 2–3 months until discontinuation, with additional assessment when clinically indicated. Review muscle symptoms, infection, capillary leak, urine output and infusion-site symptoms.

supportive_care.mapping_basis: Current regimen explicitly classifies moderate emetogenic potential; mandatory dexamethasone premedication is retained.
supportive_care.supportive_medications_label: NCCP antiemetic guidance for moderate emetogenic risk
additional_supportive_care: Moderate emetogenic risk. Dexamethasone20 mg IV30 minutes before each infusion is specified for antiemesis/apparent hepatoprotection.
Central venous access strongly recommended;24-hour pump/line and extravasation instructions required. Anaphylaxis treatment facilities must be available.
G-CSF may be given for haematological toxicity according to local policy; no universal prophylaxis is inferred.
